eq:Uhbullet: Equation3.6 belongs to the separately unselected ALE/sheaf stability face. This incidental alternative union construction in Section5.1 is not needed for the selected Section2.8 Levi face; all required Levi-face local strata, finite maps and base-change comparison are retained.

subsec:sheaf: Section3.2 concerns the separately unselected sheaf/ALE stability face. The selected Levi face is completely specified in Section2.8 and all its new local/base-change construction is retained.
subsec:ALE: Section3.1 gives separately unselected ALE examples. The degree-operator remark here is only an affine interpretation of the already cited Kac-Moody conventions.
